purpose: Demand signals scored by acquisition/lib/signal-score.mjs. Every dimension carries an explicit evidence class. OBSERVED means it was read from a measurement, a repository record or an operational document in this repository. ASSUMPTION and HYPOTHESIS are NOT evidence and must never be reported as such.
